amazon:amazon:10598441.description:
About Amazon Web Services

Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a broad set of global compute, storage, database, analytics, application, and deployment services that help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale applications. These services are trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads — including web and mobile applications, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others.

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Opportunity

For a decade, WorkSpaces has been exceptional at what it was designed to do: securely deliver a virtual desktop where a user logs in, applications load, work happens, the session ends. It is reactive by design—with no memory of what occurred, no understanding of intent, and no ability to act on the user's behalf. But work has changed. The modern enterprise now runs on three workforces: humans who set direction, AI agents that execute delegated work, and the systems that run the business. Non-human identities already outnumber human ones, yet no infrastructure layer governs all three within a single trust boundary. Whoever solves this—making the secure, governed path the fastest path—will define how the world works for the next decade.

Amazon WorkSpaces is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We are extending its trust boundary from humans to humans and AI agents working together, governed by default. This is not an incremental improvement but a reimagining of the workspace itself—from a platform that delivers applications and compute into one that actively partners with users: understanding intent, orchestrating workflows across systems, anticipating needs, and reducing friction at every step.

We are looking for a seasoned product leader to own the end-to-end product strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces and define the future of work at the intersection of human talent and agentic AI. You will treat the workspace not as a container for compute but as the orchestration layer where humans and AI collaborate—reimagining every surface through the lens of human-AI partnership, and making AI adoption effortless for enterprises that have rightly prioritized security, governance, and compliance above all else.

Key job responsibilities
Product Vision & Strategy - Human-AI Collaboration
- Define and evangelize the product vision for Agentic WorkSpaces—the enterprise platform where humans and AI age

ashby:adaptyv:77084f0d-2ac2-46da-bc3a-8c.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As AI designs more of biology, the bottleneck moves to experiments: running them fast, at scale and with data people can trust. Adaptyv is the company best positioned to become the verification layer for biology, and long-term partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs are how we get there.

You find the partners where Adaptyv can become core infrastructure. You shape the terms, and you run the deal: scientific scope, pricing, legal, and the internal plan to deliver it. You also design new partnership models and the deals that do not fit a standard quote.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the largest deals. Source, structure and close strategic partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs.

 - Set the terms. Pricing, data rights, exclusivity, milestones. You find structures where both sides win.

 - Align the company behind each deal. The lab, the scientists and engineering deliver what you sign, so you bring them in early.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deal-maker with a track record. You have closed complex, high-value deals in life sciences, AI or deep tech. Biopharma BD, corporate development or partnerships experience is ideal. We will also bet on rising talent.

 - Credible with scientists. You can follow a discussion about binding data and assay design, and you know when to bring in the expert.

 - High agency. Nobody hands you a pipeline. You build it, and you own the outcome.

 - AI-native. It's 2026: you use Claude and similar tools every day for research, modeling and drafting, and you check what they produce.

 - Low ego, high EQ. Partners trust you, and so does the team.



Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

You’ll combine strong technical judgment with people leadership—building a high-performing engineering organization, establishing platform standards, driving major migrations, and partnering closely with product, accounting, and platform teams. You’ll help shape a data platform where correctness, auditability, performance, and operational excellence are foundational.

This role is based in San Francisco.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and grow a high-performing data platform engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, career development, and clear ownership.
   

 - Set the technical strategy for high-volume financial data ingestion across payment processors, banks, billing systems, and ERP/GL platforms, with strong guarantees around correctness, replayability, and recovery.

ABOUT ANTITHESIS:

Antithesis helps engineering teams find and fix bugs that traditional testing methods miss.



Our platform runs entire systems in a deterministic simulation, breaks them in every imaginable way, and provides engineers with root cause analysis and perfect reproduction. The result is faster debugging, more reliable software, and more confidence in what ships.



As AI accelerates software development, the need for reliable verification is only increasing. Antithesis exists to solve that problem.



We are well-funded, deeply technical, and building a category-defining platform for modern software reliability.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Antithesis is building its partner ecosystem from scratch, and you'll be the one who builds it. You'll own our relationship with AWS and turn it into a repeatable engine for pipeline and revenue, then extend the same playbook to other cloud, data, AI, and ISV partners.



This is a true 0 → 1 role. You'll set the strategy, strike the deals, and get sellers on both sides working together, with real ownership and plenty of room to shape what Antithesis becomes in the ecosystem.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AWS relationship. Build executive relationships, a joint business plan, and a clear strategy for co-sell, Marketplace, and cloud commitments.

 - Expand the ecosystem. Apply what works with AWS to other cloud platforms, data and AI companies, and ISVs, prioritizing the partners that move the business most.

 - Structure and close deals. Negotiate co-build, co-sell, and Marketplace agreements with Legal and leadership.

 - Turn partnerships into pipeline. Translate integrations and joint solutions into seller playbooks, enablement, and campaigns that scale across teams and regions.

 - Set the operating rhythm. Define KPI scorecards, forecast partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and run regular business reviews with key partners.

 - Connect the dots internally. Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Sales to align roadmaps, launches, and events.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years in partnerships, alliances, business development, or cloud partner go-to-market

 - Hands-on experience building co-sell and joint GTM motions with AWS and other technology platforms

 - A record of generating partner-sourced pipeline and working against shared revenue targets

 - Fluency in AWS Marketplace, co-sell programs, and cloud commitments

 - The ability to turn technical capabilities into clear business value and field-ready plays

 - A builder's mindset: commercial instincts, strong communication, and comfort rolling up your sleeves

 - Willingness to travel up to 40%

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with Google Cloud, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or frontier AI labs

 - Experience working with global alliance leaders to turn strategy into field execution

Ashby is growing fast, which means exponential growth across every product metric: jobs, applications, interviews, you name it. We’re not slowing down, and as a result, keeping Ashby performant and reliable is a company priority. We need your leadership to do that now and in the future.

We’ve already assembled a fantastic Platform & Infrastructure team of 11 engineers (all Senior+, >70% Staff), and they’ve done an excellent job handling our growth, but the management and leadership of Platform & Infrastructure have been diffused across our Engineering leaders. As we hit our next level of scale, it’s time for us to hire an Engineering leader responsible for performance and reliability, and for building out the team that ensures those. Hopefully, that’s you!




THE ROLE

In this role, you will report directly to me, and your responsibilities will include:

 - Building and maintaining a long-term vision and 6-month roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure.

 - Growing the Platform & Infrastructure team. You’ll hire ICs, managers, and build out a headcount plan. This will include determining if more specialized roles need to be established (e.g., DB Admin).

 - Building and maintaining an excellent relationship with Product Engineering. The ideal state is that Product Engineering can move incredibly fast independently without breaking performance or reliability, and Platform & Infrastructure doesn’t feel like they’re always cleaning up someone else’s “mess.” Today, there’s a great relationship, but there’s always room for improvement!

 - Assessing and improving our monitoring and incident management process. Again, we’re doing relatively well here, but there’s always room to improve. For example, making uptime measurement easier and improving coordination with Support during incidents.

 - Maintaining vendor relationships and negotiating pricing for our critical hosting and observability infrastructure, including AWS, ClickHouse, Datadog, and Braintrust. They have a meaningful impact on gross margin and need to be kept in check.

 - You’ve managed managers. Managing other leaders is a very different ball game, and not everyone enjoys it or thrives in it. Within your first 6 months, you’ll most likely have to hire a manager underneath you.

 - If you have experience managing developer experience and developer tools, building out a dedicated team for DevEx. If you don’t have experience here, DevEx will report into Product Engineering. Happy to discuss once we meet!

A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, then figure out how to hire them and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to be exceptional. You’ll be a key leader in ensuring that continues!

ashby:confido:8a559a78-4392-4781-9710-93.description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees. 

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number. 

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.



THE ROLE

Data at Confido feeds customer-facing reports, internal dashboards, and a lot of day-to-day decisions. Right now it lives in too many places and is owned by too many people. We’re hiring a VP of Data Engineering to own all of it: how data gets into our systems, how it’s stored and modeled, and how it shows up in the reports people use, inside the company and out.

You’ll be the single owner of data at Confido. You’ll manage our Senior Analytics Engineer to start, and you’ll build the team from there. Early on you’ll be hands-on. Over time, more of your time will go to hiring, setting direction, and working with the leadership team.


What You’ll Own

 - Ingestion. Every source that feeds our data, including product databases, event tracking, and third-party tools. You decide how data comes in, how often, and what happens when a source changes or breaks.

 - Warehouse and pipelines. Warehouse design, orchestration, and the infrastructure underneath, including its cost.

 - Modeling. One set of core models and metric definitions that the whole company uses.

 - Reporting. Internal dashboards and BI, plus the data behind customer-facing reports. If a number shows up somewhere at Confido, it’s yours.

 - Quality and governance. Testing, monitoring, access controls, and data privacy. You’re accountable when numbers are wrong, and you put fixes in place so the same problems don’t come back.


What You’ll Do

 - Build and lead the data org, starting with our Senior Analytics Engineer. Decide which roles to hire and when, run the interviews, and develop the people you bring on.

 - Set the data roadmap and explain the trade-offs to the leadership team and the rest of the company.

 - Make the big technical calls on architecture, tooling, and build vs. buy.

 - Hire and lead the platform software team, owning technical direction, milestones, quality, and on-call, and convert open architecture documents into owned, dated deliverables.

Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is hiring a Director of Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Quality to build and lead the team responsible for the technical relationship with our supplier base, from first sketch through high-volume production, and for the quality systems that ensure everything that arrives at our factories meets spec. This role reports into our VP, Global Supply Chain and brings together two functions that have to move as one: the engineers who industrialize our components and equipment, and the quality systems and team that hold our suppliers accountable once they are producing.

Form's 85% domestically sourced supply chain was built for a battery chemistry with no existing supplier base, which means the industrialization playbook and the quality systems we need are still being written. You will set that standard: rigorous enough to protect a product with a 100-hour duration promise, and practical enough to work with suppliers who are learning our process alongside us. You will fly high enough to set the strategy and the org, and go deep enough to sit in a root cause review when it matters.

 Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Lead Form's Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Supplier Quality organization, growing a team of engineers embedded across battery materials, components, and equipment categories.

HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




FORWARD DEPLOYED AT HADRIAN

We embed Forward Deployed teams on Hadrian’s largest, most critical programs with the U.S. Government, the Armed Forces, and major defense primes. The Forward Deployed team works alongside the Program team from scoping to execution.

Forward Deployed bends our product to fulfill customer needs. Sometimes that involves extending Opus, Hadrian’s AI-driven manufacturing autonomy platform, other times it involves taking a new product zero to one to make a program successful. Everything the Forward Deployed team learns working at the edge with our customers is fed back to our platform teams to improve Hadrian’s product for all customers.

Recent projects have included standing up Factories-as-a-Service for the Armed Forces and multiple primes, extending Opus into new manufacturing domains such as energetics, and taking a product that was built for a single program into a $B+ product line.

 

The Role

As Director, you lead the Forward Deployed team on one or more programs and own its technical outcomes. You’ll get to run the technical side of a program larger than most startups ever get, working directly with the government, customer’s, and Hadrian’s leadership.

The team is early and scope is rapidly growing with Hadrian. Directors will help scale the Forward Deployed team itself and be the tip of the spear on multi-billion-dollar programs:

 - Own the technical roadmap and delivery. Take the program from the first ambiguous conversation to running in production, decide what Opus covers, what gets built, and what we say no to, and hold the team to a very high execution bar. The program hits rate, quality, schedule, and cost in part because the software and systems behind it work; you own that part.

 - Bring program learnings on platform teams. Share program learnings at Hadrian to improve

ABOUT MATTER HEALTH

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in affordable housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve.

As we rapidly expand, we are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Matter Health is seeking an experienced Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead and continuously strengthen our enterprise information security program.

Our value-based care model depends on the trust of our patients, providers, and payer partners. Protecting sensitive health information across our distributed, field-based care delivery model is essential to maintaining that trust.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the CISO will be responsible for developing and executing Matter Health's information security strategy, establishing security policies and governance frameworks, overseeing cybersecurity operations, and ensuring compliance with applicable healthcare security regulations.

This is a high-visibility, hands-on executive leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys building and scaling security programs within a growing healthcare organization. The CISO will work closely with Technology, Clinical Operations, Compliance, and executive leadership to strengthen organizational security while supporting continued growth.

The position will initially oversee a cybersecurity analyst and work alongside an external contractor supporting Matter Health's HITRUST certification efforts.

The ideal candidate brings deep healthcare cybersecurity expertise, strong executive leadership capabilities, and the ability to balance enterprise-level security standards with the flexibility and adaptability required in a growth-stage environment.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Information Security Strategy & Leadership

 - Develop, implement, and continuously evolve Matter Health's enterprise information security strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, clinical operations, and regulatory requirements.

 - Establish and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures covering data protection, access controls, acceptable use, and third-party risk management.

 - Build and mature security governance frameworks, including NIST CSF and HITRUST CSF, appropriate for an organization handling protected health information (PHI).

 - Lead security budget planning, vendor selection, and technology investments while balancing security needs with organizational priorities.

 - Manage and develop internal cybersecurity resources while collaborating with external security partners and consultants.

 - Provide regular security updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, including occasional presentations to the Board of Directors.

About the Team

The Strategic Finance team is responsible for shaping the company’s financial strategy and plays a critical role in capital allocation decisions to align financial goals with broader business and mission objectives.

The Strategic Finance Data Science function has four core priorities: (1) accurately and credibly forecast our key business and financial metrics; (2) ensure attainment of key targets; (3) support complex modeling and analyses for business decision-making; and (4) scale recurring work and analysis through automation and dashboarding.

About the Role

The Head of Data Science, Strategic Finance will partner closely with the rest of the Strategic Finance team as well as the Product and GTM Data Science organizations to execute on core business priorities. You will report to the VP of Strategic Finance and work closely with finance leadership to drive data driven decision-making, improve data fluency of those around you, and move the needle on financial outcomes. This is a managerial role. 

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop accurate forecasts for product usage and revenue, compute consumption and their underlying drivers, allowing for real-time tracking of key metrics performance and trajectory.

 - Become an expert in OAI’s data and systems, through partnership with Data Engineering, Finance, and other Data Science teams.

 - Design and deliver dashboards for key metrics that impact financial performance.

 - Lead metrics reviews with Strategic Finance and finance leadership to interpret trends from aforementioned dashboards and surface actionable insights.

 - Drive automation of standardized reporting, analysis, and processes across our various revenue segments and compute spend.

 - Build and mentor a high-performing team.

 - Support critical business decisions with ad hoc analysis as needed.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A MS/PhD in a quantitative discipline (Math, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Engineering, or CS).

 - 12+ years of experience in a Data Science role at a dynamic and outcome-driven organization.

 - Proficiency in critical analytical tools including SQL.

 - Extensive experience building production-ready models for time series applications.

 - Built adjustable and explainable forecast models for multiple planning cycles.

 - Experience conducting open-ended research projects on new forecasting methodologies.

 - Exemplary ability to distill complex financial information into actionable insights for leadership.

 - Excellent communication skills and “storytelling” ability when presenting data insights.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. That means being flexible and willing to jump in and do whatever it takes to be successful.

 - Knowledge of Python.

 - Prior management experience.

ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market. In the US, Polymarket operates a CFTC-regulated exchange (DCM) and clearinghouse (DCO), and we're building the infrastructure to bring event contracts to a much wider set of customers and partners. Engineering here is small, senior, and close to the business: the systems you build move real money under real regulatory obligations.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the teams that move, clear, and protect customer funds on Polymarket US. You'll own our clearing, payments, and risk systems, and you'll lead engineering for our Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) build, one of the most important initiatives in the company. This role needs a manager who has built these systems before and understands the regulatory model behind them, not one who will learn it on the job.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead engineering for the FCM program end to end: customer onboarding and account structure, customer fund segregation, margin and collateral, and the integration between the FCM and our clearinghouse.

• Own the clearing engine and the post-trade path: settlement, position and balance management, reconciliation, and the ledger that sits underneath all of it.

• Own payments: deposits and withdrawals across bank, card, and wallet rails, fraud and risk checks at authorization, and the processor and banking partners behind them.

• Build risk controls that run in real time: pre-trade and pre-funding checks, exposure limits, and the monitoring that tells us when something is wrong before a customer or regulator does.

• Work daily with Clearing Operations, Treasury, Compliance, Legal, and the DCO/FCM business leads to turn regulatory and operational requirements into systems that hold up under audit.

• Hire, grow, and manage a team of senior engineers. Set the technical bar, run on-call, and stay close enough to the code to make good design calls.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 8+ years in software engineering and 2+ years managing engineers, with a track record of shipping financial systems in production.

• Direct subject-matter experience with at least two of: FCM operations, clearing and settlement, payments infrastructure. Ideally you've built these at an FCM, futures or crypto derivatives exchange, broker-dealer, or payments company.

• Working knowledge of the CFTC framework for customer funds: segregation, margining, daily reconciliation and reporting, and what regulators expect from the systems that produce them.

• Strong instincts for money-movement correctness: double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, and failure handling across external partners.

• Comfort leading a 0-to-1 build at startup speed while keeping the controls a regulated business needs.

• Clear written communication with both engineers and non-technical partners in operations, finance, and compliance.

Ready to scale your career in a high-growth scale up where your results drive real world change?



We’re Sensorfact, Europe’s #1 smart monitoring platform for the industry, on a mission to make industry smarter, cleaner, and more efficient. Every day, our technology helps thousands of manufacturers cut energy waste, reduce costs, and lower carbon emissions through intelligent data insights and automation.

Today, we’ve joined forces with ABB, a global leader in electrification and automation. This partnership has propelled us onto the world stage, enabling us to expand rapidly and help more businesses optimize their energy efficiency, cut costs, and make a positive impact on the planet.



Apply today and help shape a smarter and more sustainable industry.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

As Head of Frontend Engineering, you will make an important contribution to our company’s mission. Our frontend sits at the intersection between a modern stack of backend and data processing technologies and our customers’ need for an intuitive way to quickly discover cost-saving insights and mission critical performance data. Our frontend engineers bring to life the product needs of our customers in a design that’s appealing and understandable.

In your role you will empower a team of seven talented Frontend Engineers, working across different value streams (e.g. Energy or Maintenance), which are multidisciplinary product teams that deliver end-to-end value to our customers. You will be the glue that holds the team together, contributing to a professional but relaxed workflow and steering processes towards standardization and efficiency where appropriate. You will also shape the vision for frontend engineering at Sensorfact, grounded in the needs of your team and the products they build. You will enable others to do their best work and develop themselves in line with their personal goals. We believe in leading by example, so you are encouraged to contribute hands-on at times to keep in touch with your team’s developer experience.

Sensorfact is a dynamic workplace: change is a constant. The way we are organized is a snapshot of today’s needs. Your job description might evolve in time to meet the challenges of tomorrow. Flexibility and pragmatism are a must. Knowing what to focus on is the key to success.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Inspire, mentor, and manage a team of seven Frontend Engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, transparency and above all psychological safety.

 - Provide technical guidance and career development opportunities to your team members.

The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

About RFA and Titan

RFA is a leading IT and cybersecurity partner to financial services firms: hedge funds, private equity, asset managers, and the firms that serve them. RFA is part of Titan, which is building the AI workforce for IT.

Titan has raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading IT firms like RFA, and put AI agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 800+ customers and are leading the industry in service quality. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT.

Why this role, why now

AI is changing security faster than anything we've seen, and we want RFA to be the one leading it for its clients. RFA's clients answer to regulators, investors, and DDQs, and they expect their IT partner to be the most security-minded team in the room. With Titan's AI agents now working alongside RFA's engineers, we can deliver security that is faster, more thorough, and more proactive than a traditional MSP or MSSP.

We're looking for a CISO for RFA: a security leader who wants to build security for financial firms from the ground up, with AI at the center of how it's delivered.

As RFA's CISO, you own security for RFA and its clients. You lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, act as the senior security advisor to client leadership, and make sure RFA itself holds up to the scrutiny of the most demanding funds. You'll report to RFA's COO and work closely with RFA's service delivery and engineering teams, and with Titan's product and engineering teams.

You own and measure success by client outcomes (incidents prevented and contained, audits and DDQs passed), growth and retention of RFA's security revenue, and an RFA that passes every client security review.

This role is remote (US).

In this role you will

 - Set RFA's security strategy and lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, who report to you

 - Build and run RFA's client security offering: vCISO, managed detection and response, SOC, vulnerability management, email security, and incident response, with AI agents doing the volume and people doing the judgment

 - Be the trusted security advisor to client CFOs, COOs, and CCOs: board and investment committee updates, regulatory readiness (SEC, FINRA, Reg S-P, state privacy rules), and investor DDQs

 - Lead incident response for RFA clients, from first alert to client communication and lessons learned

 - Own RFA's own security and compliance program, including SOC 2 and the security questionnaires clients send us

 - Work with Titan's engineers to make sure the AI agents working in client environments are safe: least-privilege access, guardrails, logging, and audit trails

 - Guide RFA clients adopting Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot on AI governance: data boundaries, connector and permission review, shadow AI discovery

 - Join sales cycles as RFA's security voice: win the client

**Director of Development & External Affairs**

Access Health · Greater Houston · Richmond, TX · Full-Time, Exempt · Reports to: CEO

**About AccessHealth**

AccessHealth is a private, not-for-profit Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) serving Fort Bend and Waller Counties, TX since 1975 providing integrated, affordable healthcare to ~20,000 patients annually across 17 locations. A 2025 HRSA National Quality Leader and NCQA Patient-Centered Medical Home.

**The Opportunity**

This senior, externally focused role makes you face and voice of AccessHealth leading three interconnected functions: philanthropic development (individual, corporate, and foundation), clinical referral pipeline and strategic partnerships, and digital marketing including SEO and AI-driven search. Fort Bend County is one of the fastest-growing counties in the U.S.; this role is built for someone ready to build at scale.

**What You'll Lead**

**Fundraising, Events & Donor Development**

Build AccessHealth's philanthropic infrastructure - individual giving, corporate sponsorships, foundation grants, and signature events (annual gala, golf tournaments). Own the full development lifecycle from prospect to stewardship. Staff the Board Development Committee. CRM management with regular CEO/Board reporting.

**Strategic Partnerships & Clinical Referral Pipeline**

Build and manage a structured referral network from hospitals, clinics, employers, schools, faith communities, and social service nonprofits. Cultivate government relations with county, state, and federal officials. Represent AccessHealth at chambers, coalitions, and healthcare forums.

**Community Voice, Brand & Digital Strategy**

Serve as AccessHealth's primary community ambassador. Direct digital marketing, SEO, and AIO strategy (Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) ensures AccessHealth is found wherever patients and partners’ search. Manage external communications, media relations, and annual impact reports.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years in nonprofit development, healthcare BD, or comparable external-facing leadership
* Proven track record: personally closed gifts, grants, or sponsorships of $25,000+; managed an annual fund of $500,000+
* Experience producing fundraising events generating $100,000+ in revenue
* Grant writing and management (federal, state, and/or private foundation)
* Proficiency in CRM/donor software (Bloomerang, Donor Perfect, Salesforce, Raiser's Edge, or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of SEO, digital marketing, and social media
* Brings an established network in Greater Houston / Fort Bend County - foundation contacts, hospital community benefit leaders, corporate giving relationships. Day-one relationships matter.
* Genuine commitment to health equity and serving underserved communities

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree (MPH, MBA, MPA, MHA) or CFRE certification
* FQHC or safety-net healthcare experience
* AIO/LLM search optimization experience

**What We Offer**

Actionstep is a pioneer in the development and sale of software-as-a-service (SaaS) products, specializing in the delivery of Legal Practice Management software. We are a fast growing, dynamic business with a global customer base of more than 30,000 and a team of over 300 in the USA, Australia, UK, Canada, New Zealand and LATAM.

The Actionstep Engineering team contributes to developing, maintaining, and running Actionstep through the delivery of industry leading technology, operations, and analysis. Actionstep Engineering consists of squads of cross-discipline software engineers, analysts and product experts who work collaboratively to enhance Actionstep software for our customers.

**How we build**

Every team at Actionstep builds with AI as part of the development lifecycle. Engineers and product managers decide what gets built, write the specs, and review and own what ships, while AI agents do much of the building and testing. We treat the harness, i.e. the tooling, context and review checkpoints our teams build with, as a product in its own right. We measure delivery on one scoreboard that reads throughput beside quality, so speed never gets counted without quality next to it.

Our platform runs on TypeScript services, React micro-frontends and a shared design system, on AWS across multiple regions.

Our Product Development teams work across North America, the UK and Asia-Pacific. Each team works within one time-zone band, so its members share a working day. This role leads teams in both North America and Asia-Pacific.

**Engineering Director – AI Products**

AI Products owns the AI features built into our products along with the AI, data and workflow capabilities that the power our platform, such as agents, open APIs and MCP, search, analytics and workflow automation.

You lead several teams through their engineering managers, and work alongside a product lead and product managers for each area.

In this role, you will:

* **Lead through managers -** you set direction, standards and priorities for a group of teams, and grow the managers who run them.
* **Ship AI to production -** you work with product to turn the AI roadmap into features firms use every day, with permissions, privacy and audit built in.
* **Build shared platform capabilities -** you make sure agents, APIs, search, data and workflow work reliably for every Actionstep product.

* **Raise the bar on how we build -** you bring every team in the group onto our AI development lifecycle and make delivery predictable.
* **Lead across time zones -** you run a group split between North America and Asia-Pacific, which means some early or late calls.

* Undertaking any other reasonable duties as required

### **ABOUT ADACTION**

Founded in 2013, AdAction is a leader in performance-based mobile app marketing, partnering globally to deliver premium users at scale. Our collaborative team prioritizes innovation and strategic decision-making, fostering a dynamic and inclusive culture. AdAction is looking for individuals who thrive in an autonomous work environment, seek out ways to meaningfully contribute to our shared success, and embrace growth both personally and professionally.

Our fully remote workforce is centered in the US, LATAM, UK, and Taiwan. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located in Illinois, Texas, or Colorado.

* *Do you thrive at the intersection of product management, platform strategy, and learner experience?*
* *Are you passionate about delivering intelligent, scalable learning experiences for associates and clients worldwide?*
* *Are you ready to lead the evolution of ADP’s Enterprise Learning ecosystem - including AI powered learning?*

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?

As Director, Enterprise Learning Platforms, you will serve as the enterprise product management leader for the platforms and applications that enable ADP to deliver learning experiences to associates, clients, and consumers. The ecosystem includes our LMSs, internally developed applications, learner-facing AI technologies, and integrated technologies such as survey tools, virtual learning platforms, e-commerce, and collaboration tools.

You will serve as the enterprise owner of learning platform ecosystem and learner-facing AI technologies, defining direction and priorities, while partnering closely with leaders across the learning organization. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon Web Services
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a broad set of global compute, storage, database, analytics, application, and deployment services that help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale applications. These services are trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads — including web and mobile applications, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others.
  
  
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
For a decade, WorkSpaces has been exceptional at what it was designed to do: securely deliver a virtual desktop where a user logs in, applications load, work happens, the session ends. It is reactive by design—with no memory of what occurred, no understanding of intent, and no ability to act on the user's behalf. But work has changed. The modern enterprise now runs on three workforces: humans who set direction, AI agents that execute delegated work, and the systems that run the business. Non-human identities already outnumber human ones, yet no infrastructure layer governs all three within a single trust boundary. Whoever solves this—making the secure, governed path the fastest path—will define how the world works for the next decade.
  
  
Amazon WorkSpaces is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We are extending its trust boundary from humans to humans and AI agents working together, governed by default. This is not an incremental improvement but a reimagining of the workspace itself—from a platform that delivers applications and compute into one that actively partners with users: understanding intent, orchestrating workflows across systems, anticipating needs, and reducing friction at every step.
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned product leader to own the end-to-end product strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces and define the future of work at the intersection of human talent and agentic AI. You will treat the workspace not as a container for compute but as the orchestration layer where humans and AI collaborate—reimagining every surface through the lens of human-AI partnership, and making AI adoption effortless for enterprises that have rightly prioritized security, governance, and compliance above all else.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Product Vision & Strategy - Human-AI Collaboration

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.  
  
Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.  
  
As Anduril's installed base grows across an increasing number of products and Business Lines, our MRO organization needs to move from a collection of program-specific repair processes and tools to a hardened, scalable operating model. This role is about leading that shift.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Director of MRO Transformation to lead the modernization and scaling of Anduril's repair operations. Where our Head of MRO oversees the collective repair function, this Director role owns the transformation agenda: establishing core processes for any Business Line to leverage, selecting and implementing the tools and systems MRO runs on, and driving the change management needed to get a fast-growing collection of programs onto common, scalable rails. You will assess where today's pockets of good activity exist, build the roadmap to modernize them, and lead cross-functional teams through the change without slowing down repair turnaround for products already in the field. This is a build-the-plane-while-flying role for someone who has le

We are partnering with a rapidly growing, cash-flow-positive AI company that is transforming how financial institutions serve their customers through advanced conversational and agentic AI.

With approximately $30 million in contracted annual recurring revenue, $30 million in Series A funding, and an established customer base of hundreds of financial institutions serving more than 10 million people, this company has demonstrated significant commercial traction.

The organization is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding its AI platform, introducing new products, and scaling its engineering organization to support increasing enterprise demand.

We are seeking an exceptional Vice President of Platform Engineering to lead this next chapter.

This is a rare opportunity for a highly technical engineering executive to join at a foundational stage of organizational growth, partner directly with the CEO and CTO, and shape the architecture, engineering culture, and long-term scalability of a sophisticated AI-native platform.

**The Role**
------------

As Vice President of Platform Engineering, you will own the core infrastructure powering a production-grade agentic AI platform.

Your responsibilities will span agent runtime, LLM orchestration, retrieval systems, AI evaluations, enterprise integrations, data infrastructure, fraud-related systems, and agent-authoring capabilities.

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

ABOUT THE CAMPAIGN FINANCE BOARD
  
  
The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.
  
  
We make it easier for New Yorkers to vote, meaningfully support candidates for city office, and run for office themselves. NYC Votes, our voter engagement initiative, meets people where they are to share trustworthy election information and help New Yorkers make a plan to vote. We publish the citywide Voter Guide, which delivers information about candidates directly to voters’ doors. Our public matching funds program ensures small contributions can make a big difference, allowing regular people to run for office by relying on the support of other regular people, not just wealthy donors and special interests. And we lift the veil on how candidates raise and spend money, increasing transparency and accountability in local government.
  
  
We believe that when every New Yorker is empowered to participate meaningfully in elections, candidates will better reflect the communities they serve, elected leaders will be more accountable to the public, and New Yorkers will have a democracy they can truly trust.
  
  
ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT
  
  
The Strategy, Products, and Innovation division leads the agency’s strategic planning and policy work, partnering across the agency to test and implement new ideas. The division also develops and delivers the agency’s product roadmap, maintaining and modernizing the systems that support our work in future elections.
  
  
The new Data department will ensure that the agency’s information is trustworthy, well governed, protected, and ready to use. As the agency moves to a modern cloud platform and data lakehouse and explores responsible uses of AI, the department will set the standards for how data is classified, managed, and maintained. It will bring together data governance, privacy, records management, open data, and AI assurance, and work closely with engineering teams, which build to these standards, and with staff across the agency who rely on data to do their work.
  
  
The department will be built in phases. In the near term, the Senior Director of Data will welcome the Records, Data & Information unit into the department, establish the data governance program alongside the agency’s cloud migration, and build strong workflows across these disciplines. Over the next few years, the department will grow to include a data science capability that supports the agency’s mission and strategic goals.  
  
  
  
JOB DESCRIPTION

At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

**About Compass International Holdings**

Compass International Holdings is the largest residential real estate brokerage in the United States by sales volume. Founded in New York City in 2012 by Robert Reffkin and Ori Allon, and publicly traded on the NYSE, Compass was built on a simple premise: real estate agents are the heart of the transaction, and great technology makes them dramatically more effective.

Following the combination with Anywhere Real Estate, Compass International Holdings operates a portfolio of the most recognized brands in the industry — including Compass, Coldwell Banker, Sotheby's International Realty, Corcoran, Century 21, and ERA — supporting a combined network of over 300K agents across approximately 120 countries and territories.

What makes Compass International Holdings unusual in this industry is that we build our own software. Our end-to-end Home Platform, the Compass One client dashboard, and our AI assistant are developed in-house by engineering teams across New York, Seattle, Boston, and Miami. Technology is not a support function here; it is the product that differentiates the company. That is what makes infrastructure a first-class concern — and it is the premise of this role. Just as Compass makes agents more effective, Technical Infrastructure exists to make our Product and Engineering teams more effective.

**About the Role**

As Director of Engineering for Technical Infrastructure, you will own the platform that every engineer at Compass builds on. Tech Infra's mission is to empower our engineers to build, test, and ship high-quality software with maximum speed and confidence by providing a reliable, cost-effective "Golden Path" of centralized tools that eliminates operational complexity so product teams can focus on innovation. You will be accountable for that mission across compute, networking, databases, streaming, build and release systems, test infrastructure, observability, developer tooling, and the AI-enabled software development lifecycle. You will support a footprint that today spans more than 1,400 services, hundreds of managed datastores, and thousands of engineers' daily workflows.

This is a manager-of-managers role in a functional area with an expectation to shape the infrastructure architecture and technology strategy for years to come. You will own a domain where the business problem is not always defined for you and the technology strategy could be genuinely open — where part of the job is determining what the right problem is before committing the organization to solving it. You will set the high-level vision and long-term direction, make the case for resourcing initiatives that span multiple years, and take on the end

Ready to be part of something extraordinary? At Cooper’s Hawk, connection is at the heart of everything we do, and we’re looking for passionate people to join us. When you become part of our team, you step into a collaborative, supportive culture built on Uncompromising Hospitality, where standards and genuine care come together to create something truly unforgettable. As we continue our exciting journey, you’ll help us deliver unforgettable experiences to our Wine Club Members and the entire Cooper’s Hawk community. Join us, and let’s turn moments into lasting memories.

The Senior Director of Engineering is the senior-most day-to-day engineering leader at Cooper’s Hawk and will play a critical role in stabilizing, modernizing, and accelerating delivery across the company’s guest-facing digital properties, Wine Club, and enterprise application platforms.

This role leads two portfolios: Guest-Facing Digital, which covers the company’s seven websites and mobile experiences, and Platform Systems, which covers Salesforce, Wings, the Wine Club subscription automation server, the Enterprise Service Layer, and other supporting enterprise applications. The role exists to bring technical leadership, engineering discipline, and delivery momentum to an environment that has grown quickly, accumulated technical debt, and now needs to scale responsibly without losing the ability to move fast.

Reporting to the VP of Digital and Restaurant Applications, this leader will guide a lean internal team and multiple external development partners across Salesforce, web, mobile, e-commerce, vendor-hosted applications, and integrations. They will stabilize legacy systems, remediate risk, and unlock new feature development that improves the guest and member experience and supports the business’ next phase of growth.

This is a true player-coach role. We are looking for a leader with deep engineering and architecture expertise who will set technical direction, design solutions, and get into the code when needed, while also building and developing the team. The right person is comfortable operating in scrappy, resource-constrained environments, can make pragmatic trade-offs, and understands how to balance speed, stability, and audit readiness.

**Scope of Role**

This leader directly manages a small internal team that spans both portfolios and is supported by multiple external development partners. There are no intermediate management layers, so the role combines people leadership with hands-on technical ownership.

**Guest-Facing Digital**

The Guest-Facing Digital portfolio covers the digital properties that guests and Wine Club members use to discover our brands, order, and manage their memberships. Delivery is primarily outsourced to external partners, with internal support from a full-stack developer and a Business Analyst / Product Owner. The portfolio includes:

* Cooper’s Hawk brand website

**The Napa Valley**
-------------------

Napa County is home to 140,000 residents who share a strong sense of community and a legacy of preserving and protecting our rich agricultural heritage. Located in the heart of California's preeminent wine region, the Napa Valley is also part of the dynamic San Francisco Bay Metropolitan Area. With its sunny Mediterranean climate and proximity to the mountains and ocean, the Napa Valley offers residents easy access to virtually unlimited shopping, dining, cultural and recreational opportunities. The Napa Valley's strategic location, natural and cultural resources, history of responsible land use planning and attractive quality of life provide the ideal mix of small town living and big city amenities.

Nuclear fusion represents the ultimate clean energy solution. We are reviving a promising 1980s magnetic confinement reactor architecture, with a unique plasma stabilization mechanism. Modern technology resolves the historical power limitations of the concept, enabling stable, steady-state confinement and paving the way for scalable fusion power.

We’re looking for a technical co-founder to the venture. This role presents an extraordinary opportunity to translate core scientific objectives into robust, operable, and scalable fusion hardware, while steering a high-impact commercial venture onto the global stage. The aim is to spin the company out of DSV over the coming months.

You will lead the translation of scientific requirements into safe, operable and progressively more capable fusion systems, from experimental machines toward a neutron source and eventual power plant.

* Lead the technology and engineering roadmap.
* Own the architecture and integration of the experimental platform and supporting systems.
* Translate scientific objectives into engineering requirements, specifications and test plans.
* Lead the design, construction, commissioning and operation of experimental hardware.
* Direct the progression from research platform to neutron-source and reactor systems.
* Lead integrated reactor engineering and design optimization within the scientific envelope defined by the CSO.

* Own the system architecture, engineering integrity and demonstrated performance of the company’s integrated technology systems.
* Define engineering requirements, interfaces, operating envelopes and acceptance criteria.
* Own integration across relevant subsystems, including magnets, heating, vacuum, power, thermal management, structures, diagnostics, controls and data acquisition.
* Lead engineering trade-offs across performance, safety, reliability, cost, schedule, maintainability and scalability.
* Own design reviews, configuration management, engineering change control and technical decision records.
* Direct procurement, supplier selection, fabrication, assembly, installation and commissioning.
* Establish procedures for commissioning, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and system modification.
* Own operational readiness, machine protection, engineering safety and facility reliability.

* Build and lead a lean engineering capability spanning internal contributors, contractors, suppliers and partners, while retaining system-level accountability.

**The Company**

colliga is building deterministic governance for probabilistic AI systems (large language models to start). It checks what a probabilistic model produces against the rules an enterprise has set, determines admissibility, and keeps a versioned, replayable record of every decision. It works mid-stream, and only returns responses that are fully compliant, thus replacing traditional guardrails.

**The problem**

Businesses deploying AI are discovering that a model usually behaves as trained with current governance techniques, but not always. "Usually" is not good enough for high-stakes use-cases, and therefore not something a regulator, auditor or buyer's legal or security teams will sign off on. As a result, AI is failing to reach its full potential for critical tasks. A governed, logged, deterministic gate can turn "usually" into "always, provably, and with evidence" for many of these systems.

We hold a family of 14 filed patents, have a working prototype and a proof of concept, and are ready to build the first production product.

**The role**

The Chief Technology Officer is the technical owner of that thesis: what is built, what works, what the evidence supports, and what the company can honestly promise customers and investors. You will be the single technical voice who sets direction, arbitrates between competing designs, and leads the engineers who build it.

You report to the founder and CEO. You lead the engineering team and own the code and infrastructure, with authority over technical direction, hiring, architecture, security posture and engineering process. You work alongside the founder on intellectual property with outside counsel and technical reviewers, including investor due diligence.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. * Bring a customer-centric, problem-first approach to product development, ensuring teams deeply understand user needs before committing to solutions.
* Identify emerging technologies and market opportunities that strengthen existing products and open new areas of value for the company.

* Apply platform thinking by promoting reusable services, APIs, and shared components that serve multiple products and business units.
* Own the modernization of the Company's technology portfolio, balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt, modernization, consolidation, and next-generation capabilities.
* Lead the engineering organization with a culture grounded in owner

Senior Vice President, Engineering

The Position
============

JRNI is seeking a Senior Vice President of Engineering to lead our global engineering organization and own the delivery, quality and reliability of our enterprise SaaS platform. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and serving on the Senior Management Team, you will turn our product roadmap into predictable releases and keep the platform secure, scalable and highly available for the global retail and financial services brands that depend on it.

Engineering delivery and execution

* Lead DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure and cloud cost management.
* Partner with Information Security to embed secure development practices and meet ISO 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR obligations.

People and organization
-----------------------

* Lead, grow and retain a global team of engineering managers, technical leads and engineers, including our engineering team in India.
* Build hiring, onboarding, career paths and performance practices that scale with the business.
* Create a culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement across locations and time zones.

Cross-functional and customer partnership
-----------------------------------------

* Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing and technical discovery.
* Support Sales, Customer Success and Professional Services as a senior technical voice in enterprise

**ABOUT POWER FACTORS**

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.\*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

Power Factors is scaling in complexity — more products, more platforms, more sophisticated buyers, and rapidly rising expectations for AI-native capability across our renewable energy software suite. In that context, the absence of a single, accountable technical vision creates real risk: divergent architectural patterns across verticals, inconsistent approaches to AI and data platform investment, and technical debt that compounds faster than it can be paid down.

This role combines the strategic scope of an enterprise architect with the credibility of a builder who still writes code, reviews pull requests, and is comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

The Head of Software Architecture acts to define, evangelize, and enforce a coherent technical architecture strategy that allows Power Factors to scale product complexity without sacrificing reliability, security, or development velocity.

We are seeking a Senior Technologist to lead the design and implementation of an ultra-low-latency electronic trading platform targeting microsecond and sub-microsecond latencies. Nearly every company in the world runs on custom software for critical operations like tracking performance metrics, handling support workflows, building admin dashboards, and countless processes you might never have thought of. But most companies don't have the resources to properly invest in these tools, leading to a lot of old, clunky internal software, or worse, teams still stuck in manual and spreadsheet workflows.

AI has changed who gets to build software. The definition of "developer" now includes analysts, operators, and domain experts creating solutions directly—and the tools they reach for are multiplying by the week. **About Runware**
-----------------

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and operates its own infrastructure, end to end. One API gives developers access to image, video, audio, 3D and language models, and our Sonic Inference Engine runs them on hardware we designed ourselves: custom servers, custom boards and a closed-loop, water-free cooling system, packed into Sonic Inference Pods — roughly 1 MW of liquid-cooled GPU compute in a 20-foot container that can be sited wherever power is cheap and available.

This is why infrastructure at Runware is the product, not a cost center. Our edge is that we run inference 30–90% cheaper per GPU-hour than our peers, and that edge is earned in the data center: in how fast we can stand up a new site, how tightly we run our fleet, and how little downtime our customers ever see. More than 20 billion requests have run through the platform for over a million developers, with customers such as Wix, Quora, Freepik and Higgsfield building production applications on top of it.

We raised a $50M Series A led by Dawn Capital, with Comcast Ventures, Speedinvest, Insight Partners and a16z speedrun participating, and we are now building out a global network of pods across the US and Europe. We need someone to own how that network is operated.

**The role**
------------

As Head of Infrastructure Operations, you'll own the physical and operational backbone of Runware: the servers, storage and networking across every site we run, and the team that keeps them running. You'll take us from a handful of pods to a global fleet, and you'll decide how that fleet is built, provisioned, monitored, maintained and scaled.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set the operating model and hire the team, but you'll also be in the terminal, in the rack and in the incident channel when it matters. The people who do best here are senior operators who never stopped being engineers, who are already using AI tools to multiply their own output, and who know what a high-performance infrastructure team looks like because they've built one before.

You'll report to Risto Haukioja, Head of AI Infrastructure and work closely with the hardware, platform and inference engineering teams, and with our data center, power and hardware partners.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run global infrastructure operations across our pod sites in the US and Europe: site bring-up, rack and stack, cabling, power and cooling integration, burn-in and acceptance, through to steady-state operations and decommissioning.
* Own the server, storage and network layers of the fleet end to end: Linux fleet management, bare-metal provisioning and imaging, firmware and driver lifecycle, high-throughput storage for model weights and caches, and the data center and inter-site networks that tie it together.
* Define how a new site goes live, then make it faster every time. Turn pod deployment into a repeatable, documented, largely automated playb

**About the role**

ShipERP Cloud is being established as its own division. We need an engineering-led leader who will own its technical direction and delivery, install a disciplined operating rhythm, and make execution predictable for customers and the business. This is a leadership role for someone who has run live SaaS products, not a hands-on coding role. You will need enough technical depth to lead architecture decisions and earn the respect of senior engineers.

**Responsibilities**

You are accountable for ShipERP Cloud's delivery, technical direction, and operating discipline. Expect roughly 65% division leadership and execution, 25% cross-functional work, and 10% customer and partner engagement.

**Execution and operating rhythm**

* Install and run a clear operating cadence: sprint planning, release management, status reporting, and escalation paths.
* Make delivery predictable: commit realistically, track against commitments, and report progress transparently.
* Enforce operational hygiene across the division, including on-time time entry, accurate project tracking, and adherence to process.
* Lead the separation of ShipERP Cloud from New Product Development

**Technical direction**

* Own architecture and technical decisions for ShipERP Cloud, within company security and compliance standards.
* Oversee platform reliability, scalability, and cloud operations, including uptime and SLA performance.
* Maintain quality through sound engineering practices: code review, testing, CI/CD, and incident management.

**People and organization**

* Lead a ~40-person team, most of it based in the Philippines, through team leads and managers.
* Build a strong Philippines leadership layer that runs day-to-day execution reliably.
* Set clear expectations, hold people accountable, and develop talent.

**Product and cross-functional leadership**

* Co-own the ShipERP Cloud roadmap with the Senior Product Manager, translating priorities into executable plans.
* Partner with Professional Services, Sales, and executive leadership on delivery, deals, and customer commitments.
* Engage directly with customers on escalations and technical and roadmap briefings, and with partners in the Oracle ecosystem.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations of 25+ people through managers or team leads.
* Proven ownership of a live, multi-tenant SaaS product with paying customers, SLAs, and production support.
* Strong cloud operations background: reliability, scalability, incident management, and CI/CD.
* Technical depth in PHP, Python, Docker, Docker Compose, Aurora DB (MySQL), MongoDB, and Kubernetes, sufficient to lead architecture decisions and challenge engineering approaches.
* Proven experience operating production SaaS on AWS, including EKS-based Kubernetes deployments.
* Direct leadership of offshore engineering teams, ideally in the Philippines, as employees rather than through a v

Shipfusion gives brands the best tools possible for building a successful eCommerce operation. We were founded by a team of long-time eCommerce and logistics professionals who believe retailers should be able to trust their fulfillment partners as much as their in-house team.

At Shipfusion, we pride ourselves on our commitment to entrepreneurship and innovation. We are always looking for individuals who share these values and who are looking to further their careers in a unique and rapidly growing organization!

  

The Opportunity:

Shipfusion is hiring a Director of IT & Infrastructure to lead the strategic direction of our IT, IoT, and Cloud Infrastructure functions across North America. Reporting to the Sr. VP, Technology, this is a senior leadership role for someone who treats IT as a strategic enabler of business growth and not a cost centre to be managed. This is the first dedicated leadership role of its kind at Shipfusion. You'll be defining the function as much as running it.

  

In this role you will...

Strategic Leadership

* Define and own the multi-year IT and infrastructure roadmap, covering endpoint management, network architecture, identity, SaaS portfolio, cloud footprint, and IoT, aligned to Shipfusion's growth and product strategy
* Partner with Product and Engineering as a technical consultant on how IT capabilities can enable new product features, integrations, and customer-facing infrastructure decisions
* Partner with Operations leadership on warehouse technology strategy how IoT, networking, and endpoint choices support fulfillment performance and new site launches
* Own SOC2 IT controls end-to-end, including audit readiness, evidence collection, control design, and remediation
* Define the IT security and compliance posture for the company's corporate and operational systems: Zero Trust principles, identity and access management, endpoint security, vendor risk
* Develop and steward the IT budget and vendor portfolio: strategic vendor selection, contract negotiation, renewal strategy, total cost of ownership analysis
* Build the IT levels framework, career ladders, and hiring plan for the IT organization in partnership with the SVP of Technology and People team

People Leadership

* Manage the IT Team Lead as a direct report, providing coaching, goal-setting, and growth support
* Through the Ops Manager, set direction for the broader IT team across Chicago, York, and Las Vegas
* Build a culture of proactive, platform-driven IT operations: moving the team from reactive ticket-handling to engineered reliability
* Partner with the SVP of Technology on hiring, performance, and succession planning for the IT organization

Hands on Architecture and Problem Solving

* Lead architectural decisions on novel infrastructure problems: new site launches, major platform migrations, security incidents requiring senior judgment, cross-functional integration questions
* Own the server compliance and corporate cloud footprint: Ubuntu se
