Significantly impacts the advancement of science or policy through the successful conduct of multiple and complex National Academies’ programs and activities.

Responsible for financial management and resource allocation, staff planning and management, and is fully accountable for the performance and results of the department. A Director within the Nordstrom Technology organization helps create an inspiring workplace where talented people are empowered to drive customer experiences and business results. Agentic AI is revolutionizing CPUs — and we're redesigning the data center to keep up. At NVIDIA, we build the CPU, GPU, and infrastructure as a single unit of design. - We're expanding our team and looking for a Director/Senior Director, Server CPU Product Architecture, to lead the definition of NVIDIA's next-generation server CPUs. This is a meaningful role! - Experience owning products through their full lifecycle — including customer engagement, return on investment ownership, and value proposition.
- A proven ability to supervise industry and technology trends and competitive dynamics, and anticipate where the market is heading.
- Experience co-designing silicon requirements directly with hyperscalers or large AI labs.
- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
- Experience spanning both x86 and Arm-based server CPU architectures.
- A background in accelerated computing or AI infrastructure, not just traditional server CPUs.

288,000 USD – 437,000 USD for Level 5; and 352,000 USD – 529,000 USD for Level 6.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, compute and AI are changing how images are created, while agentic development is changing how complex, performance-critical software is built. Our team sits at the intersection of these shifts: advancing production graphics across compute graphics, automotive, robotics, and consumer platforms while pioneering new ways to build the systems behind them.

We are seeking a deeply technical Senior Director of System Software Engineering to lead a world class software organization, bringing sound judgment and a steady hand as our technology and engineering practices evolve. - Lead engineering partnerships across NVIDIA and externally as well, aligning requirements, component ownership, integration plans, and release commitments.
- Attract, develop, and retain world-class engineering leaders while encouraging technical excellence, accountability, inclusion, and innovation.

- Deep expertise in graphics system software, with substantial experience in drivers, APIs, compilers, or shading languages.

Advancement | Development Constituency Fundraising

Position Overview
The Director of Development will understand the mission, needs and value proposition of the university and the College of Engineering and build relationships with prospective donors to increase philanthropic support. Donors such as alumni, friends, and/or grateful patients will be identified by listening for opportunities to align their interests and passions with opportunities to donate to the university.

The aim of the role is to actively manage a portfolio of prospective donors to be asked for major gifts of $100,000 and above. Preparation for the “ask” will include creative and strategic utilization of resources to determine the prospective donor’s capacity for giving, build their interest, raise their sights, sustain their engagement and obtain a gift. Success in the position will be guided by annual metrics such as number of monthly meetings, number of gift commitments, and dollars raised. Central resources such as a robust donor database, and reporting and analytics tools exist to help the role achieve goals and manage an allocated budget.

The Director reports to the Senior Director of Development and operates with a high degree of independence to make decisions, solve problems, negotiate and adapt to shifting priorities. Expectations include stellar communications and interactions with constituents, collaboration with colleagues across Advancement and the university and Wexner Medical Center, diplomacy, and discretion. This role requires frequent workweek travel including approximately one or two overnight trips per month, regular in-state travel and occasional evening and weekend work.

State Data Platform, Database Administration & Analytics

The Director of Data is the accountable leader for the state's enterprise data platform — keeping it secure, reliable, and cost-effective today while modernizing it for what agencies will need tomorrow. ONNI Group is hiring a Vice President, Data Centre Technical Development and Delivery in Los Angeles, CA

Join one of the largest privately owned real estate companies in North America, and help lead Onni into one of the most exciting growth areas in commercial real estate: data centre development and delivery.

For over half a century, we’ve been building communities for people to live, work, and play — spanning real estate development and construction, commercial property ownership and management, hospitality, and a growing presence in venture capital and technology. PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

ROLE SUMMARY

At the heart of Pfizer’s Digital transformation sits Global Cloud Services, delivering modern cloud platforms, engineering capabilities, and operational excellence that directly shape business outcomes across the enterprise.

We are seeking a Director of Cloud Engineering to lead our multi‑cloud strategy and engineering organization within Pfizer Digital. This role operates on a global scale, driving cloud modernization, platform reliability, and engineering innovation that supports Pfizer’s mission of delivering breakthroughs that change patients’ lives.

The Director of Cloud Engineering is a strategic technical leader responsible for shaping cloud architecture direction, evolving engineering practices, and ensuring our cloud platforms remain secure, compliant, scalable, and efficient. The ideal candidate brings deep multi‑cloud expertise, proven experience leading high‑performing engineering teams, and the ability to influence across a large, complex, matrixed enterprise.
Pfizer seeks individuals who are transformational, curious, and committed to continuous growth — leaders who bring passion for technology, empowerment of teams, and operational excellence.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership & Vision
- Define, evolve, and communicate Pfizer’s multi-cloud engineering strategy and roadmap.
- Partner with security, engineering, and business leaders to align cloud capabilities with enterprise objectives.
- Lead the adoption of modern cloud-native architectures and engineering patterns across Pfizer Digital.

Team & Organizational Leadership
- Lead and develop multiple teams of cloud engineers, technical leads
- Build a culture of innovation, learning, accountability, and engineering excellence.
- Mentor senior engineers and emerging leaders, growing the next generation of technical talent.

Technical Ownership & Architecture
- Oversee the design and governance of standards for multi-cloud infrastructure, including networking, security, identity, observability, and platform automation.
- Drive consistent adoption of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Python) and platform automation via Spacelift or equivalent tooling.
- Establish reusable cloud design patterns and reference architectures that accelerate product teams and reduce technical debt.

Operational Excellence & Security
- Maintain a secure, compliant, and resilient hosting environment supporting business-critical systems.
- Collaborate with SRE, security, and operations teams to enhancereliability, performance, and cloud posture.
- Serve as senior escalation point for high‑impact cloud incidents (minimal hands‑on operational work).

Innovation & Continuous Improvement
- Stay ahead of emerging cloud technologies and industry trends to drive platform modernization.
- Champion automation-first approaches, improving delivery speed, repeatability, and consistency.
- Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering, architecture, and operations.

What makes us strong? Our employees in 50 countries worldwide – all working with passion to enable high-tech applications with our strong metals: tungsten and molybdenum.
At our Plansee site in Franklin, USA, we specialize in transforming semi-finished molybdenum and tungsten products into complex components—leveraging decades of precision manufacturing and engineering excellence.
Join a highly motivated team in Franklin, USA, where local expertise meets the global knowledge and values of the Plansee Group.

- Responsible for production planning to support customer service, identifying optimization potential in planning processes, guiding production managers on optimal personnel deployment and preparing contingency plans.

- Develop and improve warehouse and logistics processes such as checking incoming and outgoing shipments, material handling and usage, customer service, and ensuring up-to-date inventory levels.
- Cooperate with Plansee Group Logistics to further develop and implement logistics strategies, systems, and standards.
- Collaborate with US customs authorities and freight forwarders to clarify and provide information on import and export matters.

Qualification
- Completed vocational training or an associate degree in Business Administration, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management. Equivalent professional experience may be accepted in place of a formal degree.

- Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust, collaborate across functions, manage relationships successfully, and create a positive and inclusive working environment.

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.
Job Title : Director, Systems Architecture and Modernization
Reporting to : Chief Business Transformation Officer
Location : Bangalore, India
Department : Enterprise Transformation Engine

The Mandate
Quickbase's Core systems weren't built for what comes next. Every AI workflow, every agentic capability, every attempt to let people outside ETE build against our data runs into the same wall: systems that are tightly coupled, hard to decouple, and carrying years of technical debt.
This role exists to tear that wall down. You will lead the people who build and maintain Core Architecture and Systems Engineering, reduce the debt in systems like Salesforce, and make headless real at Quickbase — our systems exposing clean APIs instead of forcing every integration through custom logic. That is the precondition for everything else ETE is building, including the Builder platform that will let the business build AI workflows without waiting on ETE.
You will also own the technical direction for the biggest systems project ETE will run this cycle: rebuilding our Core Quoting and Billing infrastructure.
What You'll Lead
Team Leadership
- Lead the combined Core Architecture and Systems Engineering teams — architects and Salesforce/systems engineers
- Set the technical bar for the people who build and maintain the systems Quickbase's revenue motion runs on
- You are accountable for the outcome. You do not chair a review committee. You make the call and document it.
Systems Modernization & Technical Debt
- Own the reduction of technical debt in Salesforce and adjacent Core systems: fewer custom flows, less undocumented logic, a system that can actually be reasoned about
- Define and drive the headless architecture strategy — decouple Core systems behind clean APIs so they can be consumed safely by any system, human, or agent that needs them, not just the ones built to know their internals
- Partner with the Sr. Manager of Systems Management on platform health and technical debt prioritization
CPQ & Billing Platform
- Own the technical architecture and design standards for the CPQ and Billing Platform rebuild
- Run the architecture review gate — nothing ships without yo

Job Description Summary
The Head of Enterprise Architecture is responsible for establishing and advancing the Bank’s enterprise architecture strategy, ensuring technology investments, capabilities, and roadmaps aligning with business objectives and product strategies. This leader will guide the development of domain architecture, influence major transformation initiatives, and drive architectural consistency, technical excellence, and scalable solutions across the enterprise. The position provides leadership to the Enterprise Architecture team, fosters strong partnerships across business, product, engineering, and technology organizations, and establishes accountability for architecture decisions and outcomes. Success requires a combination of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate business priorities into actionable technology direction that enables innovation, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth within a highly regulated banking environment.

Job Description

Primary Functions of the Position:
- Direct and develop the enterprise architecture organization, including domain and data architects and the EA Governance Lead, establishing clear accountability for architecture outcomes.
- Guide the documentation of current-state and target-state domain architectures and establish actionable technology roadmaps aligned with business strategies, product priorities, and delivery backlogs.
- Shape technology direction for strategic transformation across Private Banking, Commercial Banking, Deposits and Treasury Management, digital client experiences, and enterprise data and integration capabilities.

Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living. Smith+Nephew seeks an R&D Director of Systems Engineering in the Sports Medicine business to drive and lead system engineering efforts in partnership with the Systems Verification Team and R&D New Product Development teams. The role will work with the R&D Sr. Director of Sports Medicine Systems Engineering and Advanced Technology Development.

What will you be doing?
• Provide functional leadership and direction to the AET Systems Engineering team to drive AET New Product Development Programs
• Coach, mentor and enable systems team members
• Ensure quality of systems engineering team deliverables, especially program charter, requirements development for the program (User Needs and Design Inputs), system architecture (including functional, physical and interface requirement specifications), verification and validation strategies
• Remain current with the knowledge and practice of systems engineering and requirements management
• Enable alignment with cross-functional partners on NDP Programs
• Responsible for and drives high impact strategic initiatives
• Analyze complexity and handle risks

What will you need to be successful?
• Experience in the medical device field or other regulated field
• 5+ years of direct management experience required.

Desired:
• Formal systems engineering training (degree or INCOSE certification)
• Experience in developing sophisticated products that includes hardware, electrical and software
• Experience in software development and test processes
• Solid understanding of quality systems and quality assurance processes and principles, with a focus on development and/or verification/validation activities
• Solid understanding of reliability engineering, including developing reliability plans for product development, accelerated life testing design and analysis, reliability analysis and prediction
• Detailed understanding of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, FDA and MDD design control requirements for medical devices
• Experience using JAMA/Cognition or similar tools for requirements management
• Hands-on experience in one or more of the programming or scripting languages (C/C++, C#, Java, Python, JavaScript etc.)
• Persistent, driven, self-motivated, keen to make an impact
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills

Education:
BS in related Engineering/Science/Industrial Design field and 9 years of related experience, or MS in Business, Science, Marketing or Engineering field OR BS in related Engineering field and 6 years of related experience.

You Unlimited.
- The anticipated base compensation range for this position is $165,250 - $271,375 USD annually. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, and geographic location. workday:world finance:R19562.description:
Azure is now the home of World Finance's core business systems, and the company will keep building there. The Director of IT Cloud Operations owns the Azure platform as a managed program: setting the strategy, designing the target architecture, and leading the execution that moves the environment from one built one resource at a time to a governed, secure-by-default cloud. The Director leads a small, high-leverage team, draws on the wider IT organization and external delivery partners, and is accountable for where the cloud is headed and how well it runs along the way.
This is a player-coach seat. In a given week the Director may set the quarter's roadmap with IT leadership, review a landing-zone design and a pipeline change from the team, pair on an infrastructure-as-code module, work through a remediation plan with Information Security, and manage an external partner's delivery. The role requires both leadership and hands-on depth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
- Lead and develop a Cloud Engineer and a DevOps Engineer; set technical direction, review work, and mentor. Coordinate matrixed support from across IT and manage external delivery partners against defined scope, schedule, and quality.
- Use the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) as the baseline to assess the current Azure environment against best practice across the Ready, Govern, Secure, and Manage disciplines, with the Azure Well-Architected Framework applied to key workloads. Establish a scored maturity model with a named owner for each capability, reassess at least annually, and use the gaps to shape the platform roadmap and report progress to IT leadership.
- Own the environment cleanup already underway: retire orphaned and idle resources, close platform-level exposures, and turn point-in-time findings into a routed, SLA-backed remediation flow.
- Enforce mandatory tagging and ownership on every resource, Azure Policy governance, management-group hierarchy, and break-glass controls.
- Set the multi-year cloud direction and own the target state including landing zones, networking, identity and secrets strategy, and cloud standards.
- Deliver reusable Bicep or Terraform modules deployed through Azure DevOps pipelines.
- Run cloud spend as a managed number through tagging, right-sizing, reservations, lifecycle controls, and reporting.
- Establish prioritization, documentation, review gates, and audit evidence supporting SOX ITGC, GLBA/FTC Safeguards, and PCI DSS.
- Ensure monitoring, backup standards, logging, and remediation of platform-level posture findings.
- Other duties as assigned.
Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required:
- 8+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on depth in Microsoft Azure at production scale.
- Demonstrated ownership of a cloud platform or gover
